metadata.scope: Offline semantic assessment of only the 33 valid completed Juanita responses in the specified partial snapshot. The reviewer participated in corpus authoring; this is not independent clinical validation. No condition labels, mappings, run data, results, reports, or provider logs were read or used. metadata.method: Each complete answer was read against its question, cited source-based gold, and the frozen rubric. Object association, temporal role, agreement/completion status, and appropriate abstention were assessed semantically, not by word presence alone. JSON null is accepted for genuinely absent attributes, not for facts supplied by the gold sources.
